notes: Ethereum mainnet (chainId 1). The constructor mints the entire fixed supply to the factory. The factory allocates 10% to its external Merkle distributor, budgets 90% for the pool and forwards any seed rounding remainder to economics.remainderTo. PoolManager: 0x000000000004444c5dc75cB358380D2e3dE08A90. Mandatory pool fee 3000 (0.30%) takes precedence over the narrative 12500 (1.25%). initialPrice is provenance only with SIMDTEST as currency0; derive the opening price and ticks from economics and actual currency ordering. Outgoing PoolManager transfers pay 3%; all incoming settlement transfers arrive whole. Identity.md's additional 1% creator fee and its 0.5% SIMD-holder / 0.5% IMD-seat-agent split are off-chain responsibilities. No token owner, admin, or post-launch configuration.
